purpose: Compare QtQuick6's shared KDE ToolTip with an application-owned ToolTip that explicitly resolves the KDE Tooltip role.

environment.isolation: disposable bwrap HOME, bus, state, palette, and read-only project; no personal profile or product source modified

method.fixture: Production QtQuick gallery QML with a diagnostic default ToolTip, a second application-owned ToolTip, role swatches, and a real pointer hover over disabledButton.
method.owned_tooltip: Kirigami.Theme.Tooltip and inherit=false on the ToolTip, Text contentItem, and Rectangle background; foreground and background read Kirigami theme roles.
method.hover: Seven-target/full timing probe for BreezeLight; single disabled button for the three additional palette comparisons.
method.screenshots: Full-window PNGs preserve the visible attached, default, and application-owned tooltip states.

conclusion: In BreezeLight and BreezeDark, the default attached QtQuick6 ToolTip displays the Window role even while the tooltip is visibly open; the application-owned variant displays the distinct Tooltip role. In DomainOS and Irixium both roles have equal values, so those palettes confirm dynamic propagation but cannot distinguish the role. The application-owned variant follows the selected Tooltip/Window text roles in all four schemes; no static RGB values were introduced.
limitations: This is a diagnostic QML variant, not a product-code change.
The application-owned popup was always visible as a comparison swatch; this does not validate its delay, positioning, dismissal, or reuse across every gallery control.
The native default tooltip and the app-owned variant have not yet been integrated into one production factory path.
R133 remains the full 56/56 disabled-target timing/geometry proof; R137's three added palette cases cover one target each.
next: Test the application-owned role binding on one production-generated QtQuick control with real hover, delay, geometry and dismiss before deciding whether a reusable tooltip adapter belongs in the current authorized T07 scope.
